import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

"""Conventional Commits 规范：
    <type>[optional scope][!]: <description>
    空行 + body + 空行 + footer（BREAKING CHANGE: xxx / Refs #123）
本例用正则实现校验器，并附一条团队常见附加规则（描述不以句号结尾）。"""
import re

TYPES = ("feat", "fix", "docs", "style", "refactor", "perf", "test", "build", "ci", "chore", "revert")

HEADER_RE = re.compile(
    r"^(?P<type>" + "|".join(TYPES) + r")"
    r"(?:\((?P<scope>[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+)\))?"
    r"(?P<breaking>!)?: "
    r"(?P<desc>.+)$"
)
BREAKING_FOOTER_RE = re.compile(r"^BREAKING[ -]CHANGE: ", re.M)


def check(message):
    lines = message.splitlines()
    header = lines[0]
    m = HEADER_RE.match(header)
    if not m:
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "首行不匹配 '<type>[scope][!]: <desc>'",
                "type": None, "scope": None, "breaking": False}
    desc = m.group("desc")
    if desc.endswith("."):
        return {"ok": False, "reason": "团队附加规则：描述不要以句号结尾",
                "type": m.group("type"), "scope": m.group("scope"), "breaking": False}
    breaking = bool(m.group("breaking")) or bool(BREAKING_FOOTER_RE.search(message))
    return {"ok": True, "reason": "合法", "type": m.group("type"),
            "scope": m.group("scope"), "breaking": breaking}


CASES = [
    "feat(api): add retry with backoff",
    "fix: handle null pointer in parser",
    "feat!: drop v1 REST endpoints",
    "refactor(db)!: rewrite connection pool",
    "docs(readme): 补充快速开始",
    "revert: feat(api): add retry with backoff",
    "feat(api):add retry without space",
    "Feature: wrong keyword case",
    "feat add retry",
    "feat(api): ",
    "fix(core): add guard.",
    "feat[api]: wrong bracket",
]

print("%-46s | %-4s | %-8s | %-6s | %s" % ("提交信息", "合法", "breaking", "scope", "判定/原因"))
print("-" * 110)
for msg in CASES:
    r = check(msg)
    print("%-46s | %-4s | %-8s | %-6s | %s"
          % (msg, str(r["ok"]), str(r["breaking"]), str(r["scope"]), r["reason"]))

ok_list = [m for m in CASES if check(m)["ok"]]
bad_list = [m for m in CASES if not check(m)["ok"]]
print()
print("合法 %d 条 / 非法 %d 条" % (len(ok_list), len(bad_list)))
print("合法样例: %s" % ok_list[:2])
print("非法样例: %s" % bad_list[:2])
print()
print("版本推导: fix -> PATCH，feat -> MINOR，含 ! 或 BREAKING CHANGE footer -> MAJOR")
for msg in ["fix(core): hotfix", "feat(api): add endpoint", "feat!: drop v1 REST endpoints"]:
    r = check(msg)
    bump = "MAJOR" if r["breaking"] else ("MINOR" if r["type"] == "feat" else "PATCH")
    print("  %-34s -> %s" % (msg, bump))
